subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance - draft milestones
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@healthtech.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthtech.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance - draft milestones
Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf, SOC2-overview.pdf

Hi Jane / Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Per our conversation I'm attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) section focused on Data Handling & Compliance. The draft is intentionally focused on the milestone-level changes we discussed so we can align owners and dates quickly. Key items below — please review and confirm or propose edits.

Draft milestones (Data handling & compliance):
- Milestone 1 — PHI/PII scoping and permitted data types
  - Owner (Customer): Jane Doe
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
  - Target date: 2026-07-02
  - Dependencies: sample dataset/ingestion examples, classification of fields marked PHI/PII

- Milestone 2 — DPA & security addendum executed
  - Owner (Customer legal/procurement): procurement@healthtech.com
  - Owner (Redwood legal): Alex Martinez
  - Target date: 2026-06-29 (aim) / 2026-07-09 (fallback)
  - Dependencies: DPA draft, review cycles, DocuSign signatures

- Milestone 3 — SOC 2 artifacts / audit evidence shared for onboarding
  - Owner (Redwood): Monica Patel
  - Owner (Customer): Samir Patel (security)
  - Target date: 2026-07-02
  - Dependencies: SOC2 report, evidence bundles (logging, retention, access controls)

- Milestone 4 — Retention & logging policy alignment (retention windows, audit trails, log access)
  - Owner (Customer): Samir Patel
  - Owner (Redwood): Monica Patel
  - Target date: 2026-07-09
  - Dependencies: customer retention requirements, expected retention windows for token-level logs vs. metrics

- Milestone 5 — Deployment model & isolation (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private) decision
  - Owner (Customer): Jane Doe
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
  - Target date: 2026-07-15 (target close)
  - Dependencies: compliance scoping, pricing/commit decision, network review for VPC

Notes on constraints we discussed:
- PHI: Redwood supports customers with PHI under Private deployments + customer-managed KMS options; for Hosted we require specific scoping and a signed DPA — see attached SOC2-overview for typical controls.
- Retention: We can configure token-level retention and aggregated metrics retention separately. Typical default is 30 days for debug logs, configurable to customer requirements with DPA/SLA.
- Audit logs: We provide audit trails for admin actions and API access; full query logging can be enabled for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Next actions I propose:
1) Jane / Samir: confirm PHI scope and whether sample records will be provided for scoping by 2026-07-02
2) Procurement: request DPA + SOW; Redwood to send first DPA draft by 2026-06-29
3) Redwood: Monica to compile SOC2 evidence and sample logs by 2026-07-02

I've attached the MAP draft and the SOC2 overview. I'll update the MAP with the confirmed dates/owners once you reply. Happy to set a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the MAP and legal asks if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0000

Thanks everyone — quick update from Redwood legal/ops side and proposed owners/timeline to hit the 2026-07-15 target:

- DPA & SOW: I will own producing the first DPA draft and a basic SOW. Action: Alex to send DPA-draft.docx to procurement by 2026-06-29.
- SOC2 artifacts & evidence: Monica will compile the SOC2 report and the evidence bundle (logging retention screenshots, ACLs, admin audit trails). Action: Monica to share by 2026-07-02.
- PHI support: Short answer — PHI ingestion for production requires either Dedicated Reserved capacity with customer-specific isolation or Private deployment. Hosted API can be scoped for limited PHI in some pilot cases with a signed DPA and agreed retention policy; we'll need to firm that per your compliance team's requirements.
- Retention & logging: We can set token-level retention windows; recommended approach is 30 days default for debug logs, extendable to customer-required windows under the DPA. Full request/response logging for audits can be enabled for Dedicated/Private.

Proposed MAP timeline (concrete):
- 2026-06-29: Redwood sends DPA-draft.docx and initial SOW
- 2026-07-02: Customer provides PHI scoping and sample schemas; Redwood shares SOC2 artifacts
- 2026-07-09: Legal review complete (both sides) and final DPA negotiated
- 2026-07-15: Target close — sign DPA & finalize deployment model and ordering

If that works I'll prepare the DPA & SOW today and route to procurement via DocuSign. Monica — can you confirm you've got what you need to assemble the SOC2 evidence bundle (I'll forward the questionnaire responses once they arrive)?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
